changes.historical_text: You can only activate this card during the Damage Step of a Battle Phase if a Fiend-Type monster on your side of the field battles. Pay Life Points (in multiples of 100 points) to decrease 1 of your opponent's monster's ATK and DEF by the same amount of points until the End Phase of that turn.
changes.summary: Era damage-step legality, not a text erratum: the GOAT script legalises the effect only inside the damage-calculation substep (EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_CAL, hint TIMING_DAMAGE_CAL, condition rejecting anything where 'Duel.GetCurrentPhase()~=PHASE_DAMAGE_CAL or Duel.IsDamageCalculated()'), while the modern script legalises it in the damage step before damage calculation and rejects it once damage calculation is reached (EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_STEP, 'phase~=PHASE_DAMAGE or Duel.IsDamageCalculated()'). PHASE_DAMAGE (0x20) and PHASE_DAMAGE_CAL (0x40) are distinct, so the two activation windows are disjoint. No dated source for when the window moved was found; chronology unresolved.

effective.basis: TCG release of the first printing carrying the current text (SGX3-ENE20, Speed Duel GX: Duelists of Shadows)

changes.historical_text: You can only activate this card during the Damage Step of a Battle Phase if a Fiend-Type monster on your side of the field battles. Pay Life Points (in multiples of 100 points) to decrease 1 of your opponent's monster's ATK and DEF by the same amount of points until the End Phase of that turn.
changes.modern_text: If a Fiend monster you control battles, during the Damage Step: Pay LP in multiples of 100, then target the opponent's battling monster; that opponent's monster loses that much ATK and DEF, until the end of this turn.
changes.summary: Wording modernisation only across three printings (v3 BP03-EN191 PSCT rewrite, v4 SBCB-EN124, v5 SGX3-ENE20 'Pay LP in multiples of 100'). The PSCT text spells out 'then target the opponent's battling monster', but both scripts already carry EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET and both target the battling monster held in the condition's label object, so targeting did not change.

review.notes: Remaining script hunks are no-ops: the SetCategory/SetHintTiming reordering, and goat's 'RESET_EVENT+RESETS_STANDARD+RESET_PHASE+PHASE_END' which constant.lua:300 defines as exactly RESETS_STANDARD_PHASE_END. The goat cdb text matches lineage v2 (DB2-EN132, 2005-07-27) at ratio 0.9931, not exactly - the only difference is 'until End Phase of that turn' vs the lineage's 'until the End Phase of that turn'; v2 is still the correct historical index. Earlier versions v0 (LOD-010, 2003-06-06) and v1 (LOD-EN010) predate the baseline text and differ only in the 'attacks or is attacked' vs 'battles' phrasing. Same rule-profile check as Aqua Chorus: the damage window is a per-effect property flag, not something the GOAT duel-flag set controls.
